# United Global Scholars (UGS)

> UGS is a student-development partner for schools and colleges in India. We deliver expert-led, fully-managed student clubs — innovation, entrepreneurship, arts, sports and leadership — through a structured 12-week semester model, with zero burden on faculty.

## About

- **Tagline:** Leadership, Innovation, and Creativity Beyond Classrooms.
- **Audience:** School and college leadership teams (principals, directors, deans).
- **Delivery:** Offline or online, scheduled around the institution's calendar. 1–2 hours per club session per week.
- **Format:** 12-Week Blueprint — Discovery & Onboarding → Expert-Led Development → Capstone Sprint → Grand Showcase & Certification.
- **Mentors:** Industry-vetted mentors covering tech, entrepreneurship, arts, sports and digital media.

## Programs / Clubs

- Innovation & Technology Club — STEM projects, robotics, AI fundamentals.
- Entrepreneurship Club — startup thinking, pitching, business basics.
- Arts & Creativity Club — performing arts, visual arts, storytelling.
- Sports & Wellness Club — structured sports development and team play.
- Leadership Club — public speaking, civic projects, peer leadership.
- Digital Creators & Content Studio (coming soon) — reels, short-form video, creator skills.

## What schools get

- Structured 12-week curriculum and weekly session plans.
- Trained UGS mentors who run every session — no faculty load.
- Measurable outcome tracking and reports for each student.
- UGS-recognised certifications, showcases and competitions.
- Free 7-day trial session and a 3-month pilot program before any long-term commitment.
